definitions.gloss: to keep; to raise; to have (a pet or animal)
definitions.explanation: to care for and provide for an animal as a pet or livestock

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}{猫|ねこ}を{飼|か}っていた。
examples.english: I had a cat when I was a child.

examples.japanese: マンションでペットを{飼|か}えますか。
examples.english: Can you keep pets in the apartment building?

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{田舎|いなか}で{牛|うし}を{飼|か}っている。
examples.english: My grandfather raises cattle in the countryside.

examples.japanese: {金魚|きんぎょ}を{飼|か}うのは{初|はじ}めてなので、{飼|か}い{方|かた}を{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: Since it's my first time keeping goldfish, I looked up how to care for them.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{飼|か}う (keep/raise X).

ASPECT: {飼|か}っている indicates an ongoing state of having a pet.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {犬|いぬ}を{飼|か}う (keep a dog)
- {猫|ねこ}を{飼|か}う (keep a cat)
- ペットを{飼|か}う (keep a pet)
- {金魚|きんぎょ}を{飼|か}う (keep goldfish)
- {家畜|かちく}を{飼|か}う (raise livestock)

RELATED WORDS:
- {飼|か}い{主|ぬし} (owner, keeper)
- {飼|か}い{犬|いぬ} (pet dog)
- {飼|か}い{猫|ねこ} (pet cat)
- {飼|か}い{方|かた} (how to care for)
- {飼|か}い{慣|な}らす (to domesticate)

NOTE: Homophone of {買|か}う (to buy).
